Search gournal journal entries. Every filter is optional and filters combine. `text` matches every word. Newest first by default. Capped at `limit` entries (default 50, max 500).

## Input

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `project` | `string` | no | Filter to a single project name |
| `repo` | `string` | no | Filter by repository (owner/name) |
| `tags` | `string[]` | no | Filter to entries containing all of these tags |
| `text` | `string` | no | Search words. Every word must match. |
| `kind` | `("done" \| "blocker" \| "next")[]` | no | One or more of done, blocker, next |
| `status` | `"open" \| "resolved"` | no |  |
| `source` | `"cli" \| "mcp" \| "migration"` | no |  |
| `from` | `string` | no | Lower bound (inclusive): a local day or an ISO timestamp |
| `to` | `string` | no | Upper bound (inclusive): a local day or an ISO timestamp |
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Max entries to return (default 50, max 500) Default: `50`. |
| `order` | `"asc" \| "desc"` | no | desc is newest first (default) Default: `"desc"`. |
| `includeDeleted` | `boolean` | no |  |

## Output

This tool returns structured output. The shape is the [Entry list](/gournal/docs/reference/mcp/output-shapes/#entry-list).
